rawVariants.cite: 147. Thiele R. Fix H. Gondesen K.-E. , “The technical aspects of television program production on film or videotopc,” Journal , 81 : 273 – 276 , Apr. 1972 . Note : Accompanied by a video-tape demonstration comparing video tape and film formats on identical scenes, the paper was presented on October 7, 1971, at the Montreal Conference by R. Theile, Instituts für Runfunktechnik GmbH, Floriansmühlstrasse 60, 8000 München 45, West Germany. Coauthors H. Fix and K.-E. Gondesen are also at the Instituts für Rundfunktechnik. The demonstration, by itself, consisting of pictures from a 525-line electronic camera and film cameras employing American film-stocks, was presented for the first time on October 5, 1971, at the Society's Technical Conference in Montreal by Paul Wittlig, CBS Television Network, 51 West 52 St., New York, NY 10019. Both paper and video tape have also been presented by Joseph A. Flaherty, Jr., CBS Television Network, 51 West 52 St., New York, NY 10019, at the Society's New York Section Meeting on December 8, 1971, and at the Society's Winter Television Conference in Dallas on February 4, 1972. Inquiries regarding the availability of the demonstration video tape (2-inch quadruplex, high-band) for viewing should be directed to SMPTE Headquarters in New York.
